spec: docs/specs/REV5_FEATURES_FIGURES.md C-3 (PREREG_REV5b): EXT_SEL, fixed before Phase D

selection.criterion: mean over SEL_TARGETS ['dft_elst_dft', 'dft_pauli_dft', 'dft_oi_dft'] of the outer-fold test NMAE (rev5_common.nmae: MAE / mean absolute deviation of the fold's test targets), averaged over the 5 outer folds
selection.stop_reason: step 3: best candidate BASE+B1+B4+B6 has relative decrease 0.0115 (needs >= 0.02) and is lower in 5/5 folds (needs >= 4)

rule.text: Dev rows only, KRR(RBF) only (train_ml_single._make_pipe + GRIDS['KRR_rbf']). Outer CV: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261001) over the dev rows in ascending rxn_id order; in each outer train fold GridSearchCV with cv=KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261001), scoring neg_mean_absolute_error. Criterion: mean over SEL_TARGETS ['dft_elst_dft', 'dft_pauli_dft', 'dft_oi_dft'] of the outer-fold test NMAE (rev5_common.nmae: MAE / mean absolute deviation of the fold's test targets), averaged over the 5 outer folds. Forward selection from BASE = ESPLEY73: at each step every remaining block is added to the current arm; the candidate with the lowest criterion (ties: block order B1..B6) is accepted iff (criterion_current - criterion_candidate) / criterion_current >= 0.02 AND its fold criterion is lower than the current arm's in >= 4 of the 5 outer folds; otherwise the selection stops. EXT_SEL = BASE + the accepted blocks (= BASE if none; not a STOP). EXT_ALL = BASE + all blocks enters Phase D regardless of the selection.

ext_all: EXT_ALL = BASE + B1..B6 is evaluated in Phase D regardless of the selection (spec C-1)
